source.origin: Deterministic synthetic control generated by tools/core_chromatic_angle_study.py.
source.content: Hidden RGB checker under alpha zero; opaque and partial-alpha colored lines, cross, boxes, diagonal, and image-border contacts.
source.core-source-equivalent behavior: R shift=(round(amount*cos(angle)), round(amount*sin(angle))); B shift is its inverse; source coordinates clamp to image bounds; G and alpha stay at destination pixel. Rounding matches C++ std::round (half away from zero).
source.measurement composite: sRGB code-value alpha compositing; not linear-light.

model limits: Python source-derived equation model only; no Core runtime, arbitrary float image, HDR, GPU, or performance validation.

allocation model.basis: ArtifactCore ChromaticAberrationEffect.cpp source: two std::vector<float> temporaries sized width*height; each channel sample pass reads source and writes one temporary; std::copy then reads each temporary and writes its destination channel.
allocation model.timing: No C++ wall-time benchmark was run. Python sweep time is not used as Core performance evidence.
